source.title: Moon Mosaic
source.description: A full-Moon photographic mosaic from Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter Narrow Angle Camera images.
source.verification: The bundled JPEG matches the unchanged source acquisition fingerprint and byte length. NASA's official item metadata identifies this 1024-square print image and its credits.

usageGuidelines.title: NASA Images and Media Usage Guidelines
usageGuidelines.scope: Factual informational Moon display in SALAH, with NASA source acknowledgement and no endorsement implication.
conditions: Retain the source acknowledgement and original links.
Do not imply NASA endorsement, review or approval of SALAH or its calculations.
NASA marks and third-party protected material require separate consideration; no blanket ownership clearance is claimed.

rendering.sourceImageEdits: None: the downloaded JPEG is bundled without re-encoding, cropping or generated additions.
rendering.displayOnly: SALAH code applies phase shading, orientation and sizing at runtime. This is an application rendering using the credited texture, not a NASA-provided phase simulation or an assertion of NASA validation.

existingSkyMask.change: Only the SVG description was updated against release504. The project-authored skyline geometry and original mosque photograph are unchanged; the runtime masked atmosphere covers the photograph's painted crescent.

releaseArtwork.origin: Original SVG authored in repository code for SALAH release505. Only vector paths, gradients and circles; no external or embedded images/fonts, third-party artwork, religious text or user data. This illustration does not embed the separate NASA texture or imply exclusive copyright.

historicalRegisters: The historical sourceCommit and inventory remain unchanged apart from the new Moon, credit and release-artwork entries. All other media records are preserved except the explicitly documented existing sky-mask fingerprint and description update.
